explication: nRFBOX is an ESP32-based wireless exploration toolkit with a button-and-OLED interface and radio features spanning 2.4 GHz, BLE, and Wi-Fi. The README describes the user selecting tools such as scanning, analysis, and signal testing; settings also expose display/NeoPixel controls and firmware update. The source index and excerpts support several module responsibilities and shared configuration, but the main sketch was not sampled, so its dispatch links and some feature-to-module mappings remain unverified.
